subject: Vendor enrollment & PO / VAT evidence for Orion Retail
messages:
From: Marta Novak <marta.novak@orionretail.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orionretail.com
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 16:12:00 +0200
Subject: Vendor enrollment: Redwood Inference (PO + VAT evidence)

Hi Evelyn / Sean,

We're kicking off vendor setup for Redwood so we can send POs and route invoices into our AP system. A few quick asks to get you live from the procurement side:

- Please complete our vendor enrollment form (attaching). We need legal entity name, registered address, bank account (IBAN/BIC for EU), and a remit-to address.
- For tax: for the Orion BV entity we need either an EU VAT registration number or a signed EU VAT self-cert form. If Redwood will invoice from a US entity, please provide your W-9 or US TIN and confirm whether Orion should withhold.
- PO / invoice requirements: PO number must appear on the invoice (header), we accept PDF invoices uploaded to our portal or EDI (Invoice-810). Please confirm whether Redwood will accept an EDI 810 or whether you'll prefer PDF.
- Remittance: we plan net30 via ACH/SEPA. Please confirm the remit-to bank details and whether you require PO matching (2-way/3-way).
- Attachments: ORION_PROC_FORM.pdf (we need this returned by your AP team).

Can you return the completed packet and an example invoice or PO (PDF) so we can validate fields before the first payment run? Our cutover window for new vendors is the week of May 17.

Thanks,
Marta Novak
Senior Procurement Manager
Orion Retail
marta.novak@orionretail.com
[Attachment: ORION_PROC_FORM.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marta Novak <marta.novak@orionretail.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Redwood Inference (PO + VAT evidence)

Marta — thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Sean (payments) for bank/TIN items. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- We've completed the ORION_PROC_FORM and attached our AP onboarding packet (REDWOOD_AP_PACKET_v1.pdf) which includes our standard invoice header fields, legal names, and the person-of-record for statements.
- Invoice format: We can accept PDF uploads immediately. We also support EDI 810 via our partner integration, but that'll require a short mapping step on both sides; if you prefer EDI, we'll need a test file before cutover.
- PO matching: Redwood will populate PO numbers on invoices. We support 2-way matching by default; 3-way (match to receipt) is also available but not required for software subscriptions.
- Tax: Redwood has both a US entity (Redwood, Inc. — we can provide a W-9 / EIN) and an EU invoicing entity (Redwood Europe S.à r.l.). For Orion BV we can provide either the EU VAT number for the EU entity invoices or the US W-9 if you need that for US-based invoices. Tell us which entity you want on the PO.
- Remit/Payments: We prefer SEPA for EUR invoices (IBAN/BIC) and ACH for USD. For new vendors we perform a quick bank-control check — we can either provide a bank letter (PDF) or verify with micro-deposits. We'll attach bank proof once you confirm preferred payment rail.

Attached: REDWOOD_AP_PACKET_v1.pdf (contains example invoice and field-level expectations).

Planned timeline: we'll return the completed enrollment form today and can provide sample invoices and our VAT/W-9 by end of day tomorrow. If you have a preferred sample PO file for validation, please send it over.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
[Attachment: REDWOOD_AP_PACKET_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marta Novak <marta.novak@orionretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Tarek Olsen <tarek.olsen@orionretail.com>, payments@orionretail.com
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 08:27:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Redwood Inference (PO + VAT evidence)

Thanks Evelyn — that's helpful. Two clarifications from Procurement/Tax: 

1) For our EU legal entity (Orion BV) we require a VAT registration number on EU invoices. If Redwood invoices from Redwood Europe S.à r.l., please provide that VAT number and the corresponding invoicing address.

2) If Redwood invoices from the US (Redwood, Inc.) we'll need your W-9 and will apply local tax rules — please confirm whether Redwood requests any exemption from withholding.

I've attached a representative PO (ORION_PO_789456.pdf) — note the PO has a single-line subscription item with the PO number in the header and a required invoice reference field 'CustomerRef-123'. Please ensure that field is present on your invoice PDF or EDI mapping.

Also: our AP portal allows CSV upload for batch invoices (if you plan to send multiple invoices) — let us know if you'd like access to the portal instead of EDI.

Looking to have all documentation in by May 12 for the May 17 cutover.

Regards,
Marta Novak
Senior Procurement Manager
Orion Retail
[Attachment: ORION_PO_789456.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marta Novak <marta.novak@orionretail.com>, payments@orionretail.com
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: Redwood Inference (PO + VAT evidence)

Hi Marta — Laura from Finance here. Picking up the bank/TIN items so AP has everything to process payments. A few items we can provide immediately and a couple requests: 

- Attached is a bank proof PDF for our EU entity (REDWOOD_BANK_PROOF.pdf). That includes IBAN and BIC plus the registered invoicing address for Redwood Europe S.à r.l.
- For tax evidence: attached are (1) Redwood_W-9.pdf for the US entity and (2) Redwood_VAT_SELF_CERT.pdf for the EU entity (if you need a signed self-cert rather than the VAT lookup). Tell us which you prefer and we'll route the correct entity on the invoice.
- To confirm holdbacks/withholding: for US-sourced invoices, Redwood does not request Orion to withhold — standard net30 applies unless there's a local statutory withholding requirement you notify us about.
- ACH/SEPA control step: we can do micro-deposit verification or supply an official bank letter. We'll do micro-deposits if you prefer a faster setup (two small cents).

Next steps: once you confirm the invoicing entity (US vs EU) and whether you'll accept PDF or need EDI/CSV, we'll return: completed ORION_PROC_FORM, final example invoice with 'CustomerRef-123' populated, and the chosen bank proof method.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
[Attachments: REDWOOD_BANK_PROOF.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_W-9.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood_VAT_SELF_CERT.pdf (application/pdf)]
